## Checklist

- [ ] The change uses public macOS APIs and preserves the supported deployment target.
- [ ] Success, failure, unavailable, cancellation, and denied-permission behavior is truthful where relevant.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] User-facing controls have meaningful labels and keyboard access.
- [ ] Motion and status presentation respect relevant accessibility settings.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, proprietary/unlicensed assets, or generated build products are included.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, license-compatible, and documented.
- [ ] Privacy, permission, security, roadmap, and changelog docs were updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Future functionality is not described as implemented.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the Code of Conduct.
